entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Miguel de la Grúa Talamanca de Carini y Branciforte, 1st Marquess of Branciforte, was born in Sicily, and became a military officer of the Spanish Empire. He served as 53rd Viceroy of New Spain from July 12, 1794, to May 31, 1798.
